promotion: Byte-identical alias of validated c3; no rebuild. Original SP3, SP4, SP5 and c3 tags remain unchanged.

lib/llm/src/block_manager/block/transfer.scope: unchanged committed binary input, distinct from custom discovery Rust code

changes: Attribute asynchronous completed model frames using original connector metadata and allocation IDs.
Require successful load and successful model-step execution before counting external reused tokens; discard stale allocations, cancelled, discarded or invalid-load frames.
Route contextual completion metadata through MultiConnector while preserving legacy callback compatibility.
Enable source-token attribution by default for supported configurations; explicit unsupported opt-in fails, implicit unsupported default disables only attribution.
Preserve SP5 CUDA IPC context binding and all inherited SP4/SP3 transfer, discovery, W8A8 and RMSNorm customizations.
supported_scope: PP1, non-speculative full attention, one KV group, DCP=PCP=1. Async scheduling stays enabled.

cpu.evidence: 2026-10-15 targeted baseline and follow-up CPU runs; not rerun at promotion

gpu_single.environment: 11.40 A800, Dynamo Qwen3-0.6B TP1 PP1 async

same_node_dual_mp.environment: 11.40 Qwen3-0.6B TP2 PP1 async, two MP processes
same_node_dual_mp.scope: earlier c3 validation; not a new cross-node test

validation.tp16: 1064 c3 async startup and cold inference smoke passed; no TP16 external reuse or long stability acceptance claimed
validation.final_image: Pinned manifest, completion hook and native imports verified on remote builder at promotion; prior runtime image digest matched c3.

known_limits: PP > 1 excluded from acceptance; existing separate work preserved.
Cold-compute versus cached-output numerical consistency remains unresolved.
Speculative, mixed KV groups, DCP/PCP and general async cross-node cache acceptance not claimed.
L2/L3 controls use existing legacy lock mode; this validation does not revalidate leases beyond TTL.
No long-duration stability, SLO or TP16 cache stress acceptance.
Grafana new MP counters may miss the first observed positive sample; sampled-window extrapolation differs across counters and percentages are not exact request-cohort accounting.

build.recipe_context: Export changed_files in manifest.json from their pinned source commits retaining repository-relative paths. Copy Dockerfile, manifest.json and verify.py to context root. Build linux/amd64 against pinned SP5 base. Equivalent overlay contents are reproducible; byte-identical rebuilt OCI digest is not guaranteed.
build.embedded_manifest_note: Embedded /opt/intellif/releases/sp5-async-c3 manifest source_state and image label record the original c3 build. SP6 is an alias; this external release.json and Git release tag fix final source commits without changing image bytes.
